jump to scroll sideways · 1920 → 2030 · a label's last line links to its record

“Initiated in the late 1950s, with the series of experimental audiovisual concerts Vortex, organized by Jordan Belson and Henry Jacobs at the Morrison Planetarium in San Francisco, or later in 1969 by the Rainbow Jam concert at the Salt Lake City planetarium, another trajectory quickly emerged in this story, that of artistic experimentation in immersive contexts.”

Mourad Bennacer and Vincent Brault, SAT creation team, 28 June 2024

Forty-two entries on one axis, 1920 to 2030, each with the year, what happened, who did it and where. A label's last line opens its record. Where the dossier prints no year, the year comes from that record or from the venue's own: the sources sit one by one in work/timeline/SOURCE.md, and the check itself stays in work/db, off this page.

source: the SAT dossier Fulldome, 28 June 2024, by Mourad Bennacer and Vincent Brault, on sat.qc.ca — the page as pasted is kept at work/timeline/dossier.md, read into work/timeline/SOURCE.md with the source of every year the dossier leaves out. The database check runs off the page: work/timeline/check_db.py reads work/db/model (1,262 works · 1,662 appearances · 7 festivals · 53 editions) and looks up every work the dossier names. Eleven of the twenty-eight have a record; three of those titles are held by other works, and the rest sit outside the seven festival programmes extracted so far.
